mode: verbatim ingest, embedding backend (bge-m3 via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, brute-force cosine), default recall stages, no LLM
how: config.build_gateway(dict); EmbeddingBackend.put_many([(text, id, date)]) once for all memories; Gateway.recall('owner', {'query': q}) for deployed; EmbeddingBackend.find(query, 10) for ranked
notes: Backend is the embedding backend: bge-m3 vectors (1024 dimensions) from an embeddings endpoint, cosine mapped to 0..1 with floor 0.40 and ceil 0.80 (chosen on the development sets, not on this data).
ranked scores are the mapped relevance values, not comparable across systems.

deployed uses the default recall stages (min_score with the backend's default 0.50, relative_score with the backend's default ratio 0.85, fill_text, drop_oversize, redact, dedupe, budget) and the default limit of 5; ms times that Gateway.recall call only.
Deployed items are reported by the id field of each recall item; 0 item(s) named no dataset memory.
0 recall call(s) did not answer 200; 0 ranked search(es) failed.
deployed was timed before ranked, so ms includes the real query embedding request; ranked then reuses the backend's query-embedding cache.
Gateway.recall was called directly, so the per-client rate limiter (applied only in admit) was not involved.
Memories were ingested with one put_many call (embedding requests of 32 texts); ingest_seconds covers it.
